# PBR texture sets — Poly Haven, CC0 1.0

All four sets are from Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com), licence CC0 1.0 for every asset on the site
(https://polyhaven.com/license). Downloaded 2026-11-07 at 1k (1024×1024 JPG) through the Poly Haven API.
Each set has three files: `_diff` (colour, sRGB), `_nor_gl` (normal map, OpenGL convention, linear) and
`_arm` (one linear texture: R = ambient occlusion, G = roughness, B = metalness). Higher resolutions and
displacement maps follow the same URL pattern (`https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/Textures/jpg/<res>/<id>/<id>_<map>_<res>.jpg`).

| Folder | Asset | What it is | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wood_table_001/` | wood_table_001 | a varnished wooden table top, warm, fine grain | https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_table_001 |
| `concrete_wall_008/` | concrete_wall_008 | smooth poured concrete, grey, light pitting | https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_008 |
| `denim_fabric/` | denim_fabric | blue woven denim, visible weave | https://polyhaven.com/a/denim_fabric |
| `metal_plate/` | metal_plate | brushed steel plate, scratched, fully metallic | https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_plate |
